newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY-TRANSVAAL STRUGGLE TO VICTORY OVER BOLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-TRANSVAAL STRUGGLE TO VICTORY OVER BOLAND.

text.p: Transvaal were made to struggle before edging to a 30-24 victory (halftime 15-7) over Boland in their final Currie Cup group match in Wellington on Saturday.
A try by Boland left wing Marius Goosen put his side 24-23 ahead midway through the second half to threaten a major upset.
But Transvaal were awarded a penalty try at a collapsed scrum to restore a lead they had taken in the second minute.
Left wing Pieter Hendriks crossed for the first of his two tries to open the scoring and with centre Joe Gillingham also crossing, Transvaal led 12-0 in as many minutes.

Eighth man Harold Karele scored Boland's first try from their first excursion into the Transvaal 22 after 26 minutes. And when fullback Stefan Terblanche scored Boland's second after the restart the lead was cut to one point at 15-14.
A penalty from each side kept it dead-locked before Hendriks' second, uncoverted try and Goosen's threatened winner.
Boland - Tries: Harold Karele, Stefan Terblanche, Marius Goosen. Conversions: Francois Horn (3). Penalties: Horn.
Transvaal - Tries: Pieter Hendriks (2), Joe Gillingham, penalty try. Conversions: Gavin Lawless (2). Penalties: Lawless (2).
